description: This file defines the NewsletterView React component, which displays a newsletter fetched via an API. It manages state for newsletter data, modes for rendering (HTML, Markdown, JSON), and editing of metadata. It also handles loading and error states, as well as saving metadata back to the server.

methods.name: NewsletterView({ id })
methods.description: React functional component to display a newsletter with options for viewing HTML, Markdown, or JSON content, and editing metadata.

methods.name: onSaveMeta
methods.description: Handles saving the metadata draft to the server after JSON validation.
